items.title: OpenAI Auto Enabling Creative Enhancements In ChatGPT Ads
items.excerpt: OpenAI emailed ChatGPT Ads advertisers that from Oct 30 it will auto-enable 'creative enhancements' on new and existing self-serve campaigns, rewriting headlines and descriptions to fit the conversation, translating ad text, resizing images and optimizing destination URLs. The AI-adapted versions can run without advertiser review; opt-out is in Ads Manager.

items.title: Google Ads Now In AI Mode With Personal Intelligence
items.excerpt: Google confirmed it will now show ads in AI Mode results for users who have Personal Intelligence turned on, reversing its March statement that the personalized AI Mode experience would stay ad-free.

items.title: AI Slop Sites Are On The Rise. Is Ad Tech Ready For Its New MFA Challenge?
items.excerpt: A DecryptAds study found more than 2,100 AI-generated recipe sites with fabricated author profiles, monetized through programmatic ads in the made-for-advertising playbook, carrying ads from blue-chip and Fortune 500 brands.

items.title: How Amazon Ads Plans To Make Programmatic Simple Without Taking Control From Marketers
items.excerpt: Amazon Ads VP Kelly MacLean explains the AI-powered ad platform that merges the ad console and DSP so a programmatic campaign launches in as few as four clicks; in beta, advertisers using Amazon Ads Agent saw 18% lower CPMs, 16% lower CPAs and 65% better delivery.

items.title: What Frogs And Socks Can Teach Us About AI Implementation
items.excerpt: Brandtech Group partner Rebecca Sykes argues generative AI can work with messy, siloed brand data, and that brand-specific data is what keeps AI marketing output from converging into a generic sea of sameness; she explains why AI pilots stall at scale.

items.title: Dollar Shave Club markets 'perfectly good' razors as AI push continues
items.excerpt: Dollar Shave Club's Oct 20 'Perfectly Good Is Perfect' omnichannel campaign used real talent but leaned on AI for visual gags such as a six-fingered spokesperson, which helped the brand and agency Humanaut cut production to about two and a half months; the CMO says the brand is getting 'more choiceful' about where it uses AI.

items.title: How marketers can optimize their media mix as confidence takes a turn
items.excerpt: Kantar's 2026 Media Reactions report finds only 57% of advertisers confident in their media mix, yet nearly two-thirds expect generative AI to play a major role in brand recommendations and 75% plan to raise investment in AI assistants next year, while only 23% of consumers trust AI recommendations.

items.title: Personal Agents Will Drive More Contact Center Traffic Than They Offset
items.excerpt: Salesforce argues consumers' personal AI agents will start requests that businesses still must finish, and since agents don't mind waiting on hold or calling repeatedly, they will add contact-center volume rather than cut it, forcing service teams to handle agent-to-business traffic.

items.title: New Gemini tools for small business owners
items.excerpt: Google launched a Gemini business landing page that connects to Google Ads, Business Profile, Workspace, Shopify and Canva, and can take a brand kit, fonts and palettes to generate on-brand visuals for product launches and marketing campaigns, with marketing and finance skills rolling out.

items.title: The AI attack-ad nightmare is coming true
items.excerpt: The Wesleyan Media Project counts $137 million spent on 220 AI-generated political ads through Oct. 11, and an Axios analysis found numerous midterm ads partly or fully made with generative AI, sometimes undisclosed; only four states ban certain deepfake ad uses and no federal rule exists.

items.title: AI Search Tools Cited A Made-Up Concept Within A Week, Paper Finds
items.excerpt: Researchers seeded a made-up concept on sites that AI search tools cite; four English-web AI search tools were citing it within a week, showing how quickly brand-visible answers in AI search can be shaped.

items.title: What Personal AI Agents Like Meta Muse And OpenAI Dots Mean For SEO
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots personal agents reach brand websites through connectors or a browser, changing how shoppers discover and act on products and what marketers can see in analytics.

items.title: Google shows Gemini fitting shoppers into outfits built from screenshots
items.excerpt: Google showed Gemini placing a shopper's photo into outfits assembled from item screenshots rather than product listings, raising the question of whether retailers will know when Gemini puts a shopper in their goods.

items.title: Meta splits one AI agent into 14 specialists after it hallucinated
items.excerpt: Meta engineers replaced a single hallucinating agent with a thin router and 14 specialist agents, cutting prep for a new data column from up to four days to under an hour, a pattern ad tech teams running agents may copy.

items.title: I let agents plan a WNBA Finals trip (but kept my wallet to myself)
items.excerpt: Axios tested OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse personal agents on planning a trip, a watch party and shopping for WNBA merch, finding impressive capability but a gap before users hand over their wallets to agentic shopping.
